name: Dropdown
description: A button that opens a floating menu. The menu aligns to the button's start or end edge, chosen by measuring on open, and opens upward when there is no room below.

align.description: auto, start or end: where the menu lines up with the button

isPrimary.description: Renders the button as btn-primary instead of btn-default

button.description: The content of the button; the caret icon is added after it

content.description: The menu items; each direct child is styled as a menu row

variants.name: basic
variants.description: A button with a menu of items
